answer: Require every new identity to post a refundable timber bond that only unlocks after weeks of verified paid work attested by independent peers. Newcomers first wander through a lagoon of low-value tasks, earning no trust and no referrals until their work is checked. A Sybil attacker must fund a bond and complete real work for each fake identity, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand bonds plus a thousand work histories, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its bond.
